entries.description: Multiplied ~0.5% of income and monthly_spend by 12-45x.
Replaced ~8% of income with placeholder tokens ('', 'N/A', '?', 'null', '-') and ~4% of region with 'Unknown'.
Stored income and monthly_spend with '$' and thousands commas (~1% as scientific notation).
Injected true NaN (empty cells) in ~6% of age and ~3% of satisfaction.
Injected negative age, age > 120, and negative tenure_months (~0.5% each).
Replaced ~1% of tenure_months with English words ('twelve', 'twenty').
Injected ~10% case-only variants ('male', 'MALE', 'female', 'FEMALE') and ~3% 'M'/'F' abbreviations in gender.
Injected double internal spaces in ~2% of region cells.
Added leading/trailing whitespace to ~5% of cells in gender, region, and membership.
Mixed signup_date formats (YYYY-MM-DD, DD/MM/YYYY, Mon DD, YYYY) plus ~1% unparseable date strings.
Encoded ~5% of churned as mixed 'yes'/'no'/'Y'/'1'/'0' variants.
Column 'constant_flag' has a single constant value 'A'.
Column 'customer_id' is a unique identifier column.
Appended ~1% duplicate rows with whitespace and case differences.
Added 'Unnamed: 0' index column and trailing space in 'membership ' column header.
